note: Both sets are heavily duplicated restatements of the same equations (7-6) through (7-10), and both transcribe the formulas, symbols and conditions correctly with no invented values. Set A additionally captures the stated fact that the generator-torque controller maintains constant generator power in Region 3 (the condition underlying Eq. 7-6), which Set B omits; Set B's only unique item is the trivial symbol gloss 'P is the mechanical power'. Set A has one minor quote truncation (the PID law quote drops the derivative dot on ΔΩ), and Set B has one truncated quote ('on 3 is inversely proportional...'), but neither misbinds a value. Overall Set A covers slightly more of the page's substantive content, though the difference is small.
